name: Okibi Yodomi
source:
A student who always seems timid and skittish, like a small animal.

She always seems to be afraid of something, but when the topic of murder comes up, she suddenly becomes bold and at times maniacal. 

She is one of the few people capable of challenging or attacking the serial killer Ugajima Yukari.
